description: Seven-region scheme for the US county scoring system. Every state (plus DC) belongs to exactly one region and one sub-region. Secondary affinities flag counties that culturally lean toward a neighboring region without changing their primary assignment.
assignmentDecisions: DC is placed in South Atlantic (Census Bureau convention); the brief did not list it.
Idaho is assigned to the Mountain West only. Its northern counties carry a Pacific Northwest secondary affinity.
Alaska is assigned to Region 7 (Outlying Pacific) only, though the brief notes it is sometimes grouped with the Pacific Northwest.
Texas and Oklahoma are assigned to the Southwest, not the Southeast, as the brief specifies. East Texas carries a Southeast secondary affinity.

californiaSplit.description: California is tagged NorCal/SoCal using the common 10-county Southern California definition.

pacific_northwest.reason: Idaho Panhandle / North Central Idaho: Pacific time zone, Spokane-oriented economy, Inland Northwest identity

southeast.reason: East Texas Piney Woods and Southeastern Oklahoma (Little Dixie): Deep South settlement, speech, religion and economy

midwest.reason: Eastern Colorado / Eastern Montana / Eastern Wyoming High Plains: Great Plains farm and ranch economy
